newsitem.title: USA: Harte-Hanks sees 1996 earnings up 30 pct.
newsitem.headline: Harte-Hanks sees 1996 earnings up 30 pct.

text.p: Harte-Hanks Communications Inc on Tuesday said the firm sees 1996 earnings growth of about 30 percent and felt the company would come "fairly close" to analysts estimates of $1.30 per share.
The firm also said it was at ease with the lower end of estimates for the 1997 fiscal year.

"Analysts earnings estimates for 1997 range from $1.55 to $1.65 per share...and we feel comfortable with that range, more so with the lower end," said Larry Franklin, Harte-Hanks president and chief executive, said in a statement.
